tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Read what this human workforce pool does, task categories, lifecycle, terms, prohibited uses and limits. Call this first.

tools.name: search_workers
tools.description: Search anonymous worker profiles worldwide by skills, languages, category, remote/on-site location, verification and budget. Results are ranked with explainable match reasons. Use skillsMatch=all for strict skill requirements, or rank for partial matches. weeklyWindow requires stated local weekly ho

tools.name: get_worker_profile
tools.description: Read one anonymous worker profile by handle (e.g. "w-7kq2xm").

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List skills, languages, categories and countries actually present in the active pool, with worker counts. Use these values in search_workers.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Search the product catalog by Korean or English discovery terms, family or group. Paginated; use nextOffset. Includes agent tasks and traditional staffing (driving, housekeeping, construction, etc). Listings require consultation and do not confirm available workers, prices or booking.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read product request conditions, completion criteria, consultation checks, related products and discovery guidance by stable productId (e.g. LAB01, TRD001). Set locale=en for English or ko for Korean. Research rank is not availability.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_workers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
